phases.name: Engineering foundation

successCriteria: Canonical Milestones 1-5 closed with documented evidence

risks: Regression if future workflow edits bypass hardened conditions

phases.evidence: nycif-live-feeds Canonical Milestone 1-5 closure reports and merged PRs.

phases.name: GPS and event identity integrity
phases.purpose: Deliver one reliable, deduplicated, location-validated event identity for every downstream layer to trust.
successCriteria: PR #143 merged
one canonical shared normalization/identity implementation
explicit duplicate-key detection
positional review arrays deprecated or removed
offline migration-compatibility regression tests passing
risks: Merging PR #143 without independent review
starting Milestone 7 before PR #143 lands
silent reintroduction of duplicated normalization logic
completionRequirements: no live-source, production, or publishing behavior changed without separate authorization
phases.runtimeImpact: None from this phase's own scope (pipeline-internal, staged data only).
phases.evidence: completionPercent basis: Canonical Milestone 6 is implementation-complete but unmerged (treated as 90% of this phase's Milestone-6 half, i.e. 45 of a 50-point share); Milestone 7 has not started (0 of its 50-point share). (0.5 x 90) + (0.5 x 0) = 45. live-feeds PR #143 is open, not merged, as of 2026-07-12.

phases.name: App-facing API
phases.purpose: Expose stable, versioned, read-only event, nearby-search, significance, and article endpoints for every client.
successCriteria: Versioned endpoint contract
pagination, caching, rate limits, and error contract implemented
nearby search never returns other users' coordinates
significance tiers computed from evidence signals only
risks: Building against an unstable event-identity model before Phase 2 closes
accidentally exposing raw ingestion coordinates
completionRequirements: no write path into the production event store
phases.runtimeImpact: Would introduce a new production-facing read service. Requires separate explicit authorization before any deployment.
phases.evidence: None. No implementation, deployment, or runtime evidence exists for this phase. Status is planned only.

phases.name: Accounts and identity
phases.purpose: Provide authentication, session management, and account lifecycle including deletion, independent of location identity.
successCriteria: Account creation, login, session handling, and account deletion implemented
browsing the map and reading rooms requires no account
risks: Conflating account identity with location identity
retaining deleted-account data beyond policy
completionRequirements: Account deletion is a real, tested, irreversible data-removal path, not a soft flag
phases.runtimeImpact: Would introduce a production identity store. Requires separate authorization before any deployment.
phases.evidence: None. No implementation, deployment, or runtime evidence exists for this phase. Status is planned only.

phases.name: Location verification and geofencing
phases.purpose: Provide server-side, privacy-preserving verification that a user is physically inside an approved ZIP Code boundary.
successCriteria: Point-in-polygon check performed server-side only
response is a boolean eligibility decision plus a short-lived token
no coordinates, distance, or movement history returned or retained beyond the verification request
risks: Any client-side polygon check
persisting precise coordinates past the verification window
completionRequirements: Token expiry and re-verification implemented and tested
no coordinate ever logged in a client-visible or public path
phases.runtimeImpact: Would introduce a production location-verification service. Requires separate authorization before any deployment.
phases.evidence: None. No implementation, deployment, or runtime evidence exists for this phase. Status is planned only.

phases.name: Real-time ZIP Code chat
phases.purpose: Deliver borough/ZIP room browsing (public, read-only) and posting (geofence-gated) with real-time message delivery.
successCriteria: Public read access requires no token or location permission
posting requires a valid, unexpired geofence token
message ordering, reconnection, and media-attachment policy defined and tested
risks: Launching posting without moderation in place
storing the chat database anywhere in a public repository
completionRequirements: Chat store is private infrastructure only, never committed publicly
Phase 7 trust-and-safety controls ship no later than public chat launch
phases.runtimeImpact: Would introduce a production real-time messaging service. Requires separate authorization before any deployment.
phases.evidence: None. No implementation, deployment, or runtime evidence exists for this phase. Status is planned only.

phases.name: Trust and safety
phases.purpose: Provide report, block, mute, moderator tooling, rate limiting, and unverified-content labeling required before any public chat launch.
successCriteria: Report/block/mute flows implemented
moderator dashboard and action log implemented

community reports labeled as unverified until independently confirmed
risks: Treating trust-and-safety as a post-launch addition (explicitly disallowed by ADR-004)
completionRequirements: All success criteria implemented and tested before Phase 6's posting capability is enabled in production
phases.runtimeImpact: Adds moderation actions and audit logging to the production chat service.

releaseReadiness.note: No platform-product surface is release-ready. Only Phase 1 (engineering foundation) in nycif-live-feeds is complete; Phase 2 is in progress and unmerged.

criticalDependencies: live-feeds PR #143 must be independently reviewed and merged before Phase 2 can be considered complete.
Phase 2 (GPS and event identity integrity) must complete before Phase 3 (App-facing API) may be authorized.
Phase 3 (App-facing API) blocks Phase 8 (story/editorial integration), Phase 9 (push notifications), Phase 10 (mobile), and Phase 12 (revenue).
Phase 4 (accounts) blocks Phase 5 (geofencing), which blocks Phase 6 (chat), which blocks Phase 7 (trust and safety), which blocks Phase 10 (mobile).
Phase 10 (mobile) blocks Phase 11 (app-store launch), which is required before widgets/newsletter (post-launch) or in-app-purchase revenue products ship.

riskRegister.risk: Merging live-feeds PR #143 without independent review
riskRegister.mitigation: Require separate explicit review-and-merge authorization, per established repository practice.

riskRegister.risk: Building the app-facing API against an unstable identity model
riskRegister.mitigation: Do not authorize Phase 3 until Phase 2 (PR #143 merge + Milestone 7) is complete.

riskRegister.risk: Launching real-time chat posting before trust-and-safety tooling exists
riskRegister.mitigation: ADR-004: moderation is a launch requirement, not a post-launch addition; Phase 7 gates Phase 6's posting capability in production.

riskRegister.risk: Sponsorship or premium revenue features influencing Gold/Silver/Bronze significance
riskRegister.mitigation: Explicit non-negotiable rule and dependency-graph rule: no revenue feature may write to or weight significance computation.

riskRegister.risk: Overstating phase completion without runtime evidence
riskRegister.mitigation: Every phase's evidence field must cite a checkable artifact or explicitly state none exists; completion percentages must show their basis.
ADR-002 and the dependency graph's forbidden-bypass list: server-side verification only.

updatePolicy: Do not invent completion percentages without explaining their basis in the evidence field. Future product phases should ordinarily remain planned and near zero until implementation evidence exists. Any change to a phase's status or completionPercent must cite the specific PR, commit, or test report that justifies it, or explicitly state that no such evidence exists.
